task_scope: candidate event-only reconstruction inference; no real-data score, checkpoint choice, or parameter tuning

sequence.name: bike_bay_hdr
sequence.raw_event_schema: events_xy[N,2]=(x,y) pixels; events_ts[N] seconds; events_p[N] uint8 0=OFF/1=ON; EVREAL maps p to -1/+1 for its between_frames voxelizer
sequence.event_voxel_schema: EVREAL MemMapDataset, num_bins=5, method=between_frames, shape [5,H,W], no additional event normalization
sequence.image_array_schema: images[N,H,W,1] used only by EVREAL item packaging for shape bookkeeping; no reference pixel enters model or score
sequence.source_default_length_note: pinned MemMapDataset.__len__ returns num_frames-1; this local inference-only adapter extends this instance to num_frames so the final legal endpoint is also processed; no EVREAL source files changed

registered_inference.sequence_selection: first alphabetic sequence from the official 14-sequence inventory
registered_inference.saved_subset_rule: save every 100th adapter output (0,100,...) and the final adapter output; deduplicate
